crossRefs.note: Bless Yahweh, my soul. Yahweh, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.
He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.
“I watched until thrones were placed, and one who was ancient of days sat. His clothing was white as snow, and the hair…

translations.web: His clothing became glistening, exceedingly white, like snow, such as no launderer on earth can whiten them.
translations.bsb: His clothes became radiantly white, brighter than any launderer on earth could bleach them.
translations.kjv: And his raiment became shining, exceeding white as snow; so as no fuller on earth can white
translations.asv: and his garments became glistering, exceeding white, so as no fuller on earth can whiten them.
